title: sceptridium minus
intro: Sceptridium minus, commonly known as Chinese parasol or Chinese parasol fern, is a type of medicinal plant that belongs to the family Asparagaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sceptridium minus include expectorant, anti-tussive, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help relieve cough, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Sceptridium minus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
